question: The naturally occurring gas that is generated by the breakdown of organic matter by anaerobic bacteria and is used in energy production is called:
solution:
The correct answer is__** Biogas.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **anaerobic digestion procedure** makes gas composed of methane **(CH4) and carbon dioxide (CO2), known as biogas.**
 
• These gases are manufactured from **organic wastes** like livestock manure, food processing waste, etc.
 
• Biogas is an **energy-rich gas** manufactured by anaerobic decomposition or thermochemical conversion of biomass. 
 
• Biogas is composed mainly of **methane (CH4)**, the same compound in natural gas, and carbon dioxide (CO2).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **CNG** is manufactured by compressing natural gas to **less than 1%** of its volume at standard atmospheric pressure. 
 
• **Natural gas**, also famous as **methane gas**, is colourless very flammable gaseous hydrocarbon consisting primarily of **methane and ethane.** 
 
• **liquefied petroleum gas (LPG),** also known as **LP gas**, any of some liquid combinations of the volatile hydrocarbons** propene, propane, butene, and butane. **​
